name: gaming-payments-orders
description: Payment and order state machines, processor callbacks, pricing, refunds, and idempotency.
objectives: Test price and currency integrity, order-state transitions, idempotency, replay resistance, concurrent requests, refund controls, and webhook signature validation.
Exercise authorized business-logic chains across checkout, payment confirmation, fulfillment, refunds, and account entitlements.
Verify that payment and order records cannot be accessed or altered across accounts.
operational_constraints: Use the payment processor sandbox and operator-provided test payment methods only.
Never submit a real charge or refund, and do not use live cardholder data or production webhook secrets.
